content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks nigeria

The absence of platforms like PayPal and Stripe in Nigeria is a significant barrier for digital creators. Only 46 countries out of 195 have access to Stripe, leaving many creators without effective means to sell their products. This exclusion not only impacts the ability to earn but also restricts the growth of a vibrant digital economy. A sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the COREMERCH solution, provides an alternative that empowers creators to maintain ownership and control over their sales process. This framework allows for direct payments in cryptocurrency, thus bypassing the restrictions imposed by conventional payment gateways.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure operates on a combination of free tools that seamlessly work together to provide an efficient selling platform. For instance, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages can host your store, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Order storage can be managed via Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring that you own your data. The integration of NOWPayments facilitates automatic on-chain crypto payment processing, requiring only a 0.5% fee. This architecture is designed to be resilient and adaptable, providing you with a solid foundation for your digital sales without reliance on conventional platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where payment processing systems like PayPal and Stripe are unavailable or heavily restricted. If you are a creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or similar regions, you can now sell your ebooks, courses, or digital products without fear of payment rejection or account suspension. By choosing a sovereign commerce stack, you not only gain access to a reliable sales channel but also ensure that your funds are secure and accessible without arbitrary holds, such as the up to 180 days that PayPal can impose on suspended accounts.
No platform dependency means you control your sales process completely.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The COREMERCH ecosystem consists of several interlocking components that function together to create a robust digital sales platform. By deploying the Edge Commerce Stack for $197, you gain access to Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, and Supabase for data management. With the integration of NOWPayments, you can accept multiple cryptocurrencies with minimal transaction fees. Each of these components has been meticulously tested to ensure they work flawlessly together, allowing you to focus on creating and selling your digital products rather than managing technical issues.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling ebooks in Nigeria, first, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore the available options. Choose the Edge Commerce Stack for $197, which will be deployed in 48 hours. After deployment, load your digital products and configure your settings according to the provided documentation. Ensure that your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings are correctly configured for email verification. Finally, test the entire system to confirm that payments are being processed smoothly before launching your store to the public.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Avoid long holds on your funds with traditional payment processors.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
